FIN-14.notes: DEFECT: no duplicate detection on invoice_line_id or business key (invoice_id+sku+date+qty+price); duplicates double-count leakage. Billing adjustments are also keyed by line id, so a duplicate ID would get the credit/debit applied twice.

FIN-15.actual: qty 10 x $95 but line amount $960 -> status=POTENTIAL_UNDERBILLING, underbilling=40.00 (engine uses the supplied line amount); no inconsistency flag

EXT-02.actual: invoiced_unit_price blank -> POTENTIAL_UNDERBILLING under=50.00 | invoiced_line_amount blank -> CRASH (InvalidOperation: [<class 'decimal.InvalidOperation'>]) | invoice_date blank -> CRASH (TypeError: fromisoformat: argument must be str) | quantity blank -> CRASH (InvalidOperation: [<class 'decimal.InvalidOperation'>]) | currency blank -> POTENTIAL_UNDERBILLING under=50.00 | contract_id blank -> REVIEW under=nan
EXT-02.notes: DEFECT: no row-level input validation. Blank date/qty/amount raise an uncaught exception that aborts the whole run; blank currency is accepted silently (see FIN-09). Recommend a validation step that sends bad rows to REVIEW with a reason.

EXT-03.actual: '2024-06-15' -> MATCH | '15/06/2024' -> CRASH (ValueError: Invalid isoformat string: '15/06/2024') | '06/15/2024' -> CRASH (ValueError: Invalid isoformat string: '06/15/2024') | '20240615' -> MATCH | '' -> CRASH (TypeError: fromisoformat: argument must be str) | '2024-13-45' -> CRASH (ValueError: month must be in 1..12)
EXT-03.notes: Only ISO dates are supported (date.fromisoformat, which also accepts compact '20240615'). That is a reasonable policy but it is not documented, and any non-ISO/blank/invalid date crashes the whole run instead of being rejected per row.

EXT-04.actual: qty -5 @100 -> MATCH under=0.00 over=0.00 | price -100 -> POTENTIAL_UNDERBILLING under=2000.00 over=0.00 | price 0 -> POTENTIAL_UNDERBILLING under=1000.00 over=0.00 | qty 0 -> MATCH under=0.00 over=0.00
EXT-04.notes: Negative quantity is reconciled as a normal line (a -5 x $100 line billed at -$500 is a MATCH; billed at $0 it becomes $500 of overbilling). Negative/zero prices are processed with no flag. No documented credit/return semantics - recommend rejecting or routing to REVIEW.

EXT-05.notes: One malformed row stops the entire hunt with a raw traceback; valid rows produce no output. Contract extraction, by contrast, already isolates per-file failures (run_extraction.py).
